title: Mangrove Area Fell To 15.2 Million Hectares
hook: Mangrove area fell to 15.2 million hectares.
closing: Slower losses show protection works, but every missing mangrove still leaves coastlines more exposed.
question: Can mangrove protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove area fell to 15.2 million hectares. Coastlines lost part of their natural storm barrier.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves. It carried the largest regional loss shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102 thousand hectares. Protection can reduce destruction even before it stops it.
